faq.q: How did the Abbotsford market sit in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 440 active listings, 45 sold and a median sale price of $949,000; Condos & Townhomes recorded 572 listings, 58 sold and a median of $497,500. These are community figures for all nine Abbotsford sub-areas combined — board context, not open-house figures; SnapStats publishes no open-house category and no per-sub-area medians (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Who does the hosting agent at an Abbotsford open house represent?
faq.a: The seller: BCFSA states a licensed professional must only work for either the buyer or the seller in a transaction and must inform unrepresented consumers of the risks of dealing with a professional representing another party; disclosure of representation is not required for the hosting itself under Rule 5-10(3), unless the host solicits or receives information about your motivation, financial qualifications or needs.
